biotools.summary: The Cytoplasmic Editing Index (CEI) is an open-source pipeline designed to quantify ADAR1-mediated adenosine-to-inosine RNA editing specifically within cytoplasmic transcripts. It is crucial for assessing the immunogenicity risk associated with endogenous double-stranded RNA structures in the life sciences.
